elements.flag: Hands already in view at start; they only rest.
elements.label: Idle before cycle
elements.observed: Three loose parts on the table: pink 1×6 brick, white plate, blue 2×2 slope. Both hands rest at the frame edges, not touching parts.

elements.label: Reach and grasp pink 1×6 brick
elements.observed: Hand from the top right moves to the pink brick and picks it up between the fingertips.

elements.flag: Overlaps the pick and placement: both hands working at once.
elements.label: Hold the base plate
elements.observed: Second hand enters from the bottom right and reaches the white plate.

elements.label: Place pink brick on plate
elements.observed: Pink brick brought down onto the plate by the first hand, second hand beside it.

elements.flag: Pressing and seating hidden by hands; longest element so far.
elements.label: Press pink brick down
elements.observed: Fingertips of both hands stay on the pink brick and plate; the hands hide most of the join.

elements.label: Reach and grasp blue 2×2 slope
elements.observed: First hand moves from the plate to the blue slope on the table and picks it up.

elements.label: Carry blue slope
elements.observed: Blue slope carried to the pink brick and plate.

elements.flag: Possible in-hand adjustment; a re-grip can't be confirmed.
elements.label: Position and orient blue slope
elements.observed: Slope held above the plate beside the pink brick and adjusted in the fingers before going down.

elements.flag: Hidden by hands; pressing and any re-press cannot be counted.
elements.label: Press blue slope down
elements.observed: Both hands on the assembly; the slope and pink brick are mostly hidden by the fingers.

elements.label: Release and set down
elements.observed: Hands let go of the assembly, which stays on the table; both hands withdraw to the right edge by about 7.3 s.

elements.flag: Frame shift while hands are still in view; likely camera movement.
elements.label: Idle after cycle
elements.observed: Finished assembly alone on the table; hands only at the right frame edge. Camera view shifts from about 6.6 s.

finalState.note: Pink 1×6 brick lies along the plate with the blue slope next to it and a free row of white studs, which resembles the baseline layout. Small at this scale, so exact stud positions and slope direction can't be confirmed.

limitations: Seating can't be confirmed: both pressing phases are hidden by hands, so presses can't be counted.
Boundaries between place, press and pick are approximate (±0.1–0.2 s) because the hands hide the parts.
One run compared with one baseline: no variance to judge whether 6.4 s is typical.
Top-down 2D view: no height or gap information; the final layout is small in frame.
Camera moved from about 6.6 s, so object movement can't be fully separated from camera movement.
Audio (snap sounds) was not analyzed; defects, operator intent and anything outside the recording are not visible.
processData: Cycle start and end and cycle time (about 6.4 s)
Element sequence compared with the baseline order
Time per element, e.g. both pressing phases together about 3.3 s of the cycle
Parts handled: 3 of 3, each picked once, no drops
Two-hand overlap from about 1.5 s to 7.3 s
Handling events: 1 possible in-hand adjustment, 0 confirmed repeats
Final-state check against a reference image
Confidence per element: how much was hidden by hands

source.note: Claude Code routine, frame by frame at 0.1 s steps

statusNote: Same sequence as the baseline: pink brick, plate, then blue slope, each handled once with no drops. Cycle about 6.4 s versus 5.5 s for the baseline; hidden pressing is flagged unclear, not as a deviation.
